verse: The tradition sums up Pāṇini's sūtras in one verse: definition, meta-rule, operation, restriction, extension and heading. Six kinds, six jobs. Tap each word of the verse to meet one example.
sort: Let's see if you can tell them apart. Tap a sūtra, then tap the kind you think it is. Hints appear if you get stuck.
counts: How are they spread through the text? Operational rules dominate, but the small groups do heavy lifting. Tap a bar to see examples of that kind.
niyama: A restriction looks like an ordinary rule, but its job is to narrow another rule. पतिः समास एव says पति gets the term घि only inside a compound. Compare पत्या with हरिणा.
quiz: Four quick questions, then the verse to keep.
